|---|---|---|

| **Shipping** | Free standard, 3-5 business days, In stock | Free standard, 3-5 business days, In stock |

| **Specs/Box** | Identical - 40hr battery, ANC, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite | Identical - 40hr battery, ANC, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns** | **30-day returns, you pay return shipping** |

**Why A is better:**

Everything else is identical - price, shipping speed, warranty, rating, and what's in the box. That is strictly better if the headphones don't fit, you don't like the sound/ANC, or there's an issue.

There's no advantage to buying from Brackmoor Sound based on the listed information.
